title: Chapter 247: Second Expansion
html:
“Cigarette burns?” Chen Ge remembered the man who had occupied the first seat on the right at the Ghost Stories Society. His exposed little finger bore just such a mark.

“We reviewed twelve hours of footage from cameras within five hundred meters. No one else appeared particularly suspicious, but this man caught our attention.” Suspicion colored Captain Yan’s voice. “His hood concealed his face, and his phone’s screen was dark. He pretended to be making a call while actually surveying the area. One thing still puzzles me: why was he holding a flyer for your Haunted House?”

“My Haunted House has very few employees, and we don’t distribute flyers outside the park. Either he or one of his associates must have visited.”

“Do you have any recollection of this man?”

“The Haunted House contains several scenarios, and I’m responsible for only one, so I can’t answer with certainty.” Chen Ge was already considering how to deal with the man. “Captain Yan, you must have investigated him before identifying him as suspicious. What did you learn?”

Captain Yan’s voice was hoarse, probably from lack of sleep. “He produces programs for a private radio station. He has no criminal record and is regarded as a successful family man with a respectable career. He isn’t someone we would normally consider a suspect.”

“A radio station’s producer? That sounds impressive.”

“The station specializes in late-night programming. Its audience has grown over the past two years, primarily among curious young people and insomniacs with time to spare.”

Captain Yan’s revelation banished Chen Ge’s drowsiness. Only one Jiujiang station specialized in late-night programs: Ghost Talk, where No. 12—Lychee—worked. Before changing formats, the station had focused on relationship advice, but declining ratings forced it to adapt. Its first Ghost Talk broadcast had broken records.

“Captain Yan, the radio station you’re talking about is Ghost Talk?”

“Yes, that’s the one. You’ve heard of it before?”

“A few times. One host, Lychee, has a wonderful voice.” Chen Ge’s thoughts raced. If No. 5 was the station’s producer and Lychee worked beneath him, could he have sent her the Ghost Stories Society flyer?

If so, Chen Ge had uncovered the identities of two members.

“We don’t know why he appeared at Hai Ming Apartments, but we chose not to question him and risk alerting him.” Captain Yan sounded exhausted. “Too much has happened lately. Take care of yourself, and call us if you discover anything.”

Captain Yan ended the call soon afterward. Sitting on the edge of his bed, Chen Ge searched for the station online. Lychee was indeed absent from that night’s schedule; another host had replaced her.

Should I strike first? Take them down one by one?

…

Around seven in the morning, shortly after sunrise, a vibration woke Chen Ge. He searched through his clothes before realizing the alert came from the black phone.

“Failed to unlock the two-star scenario Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy! Insufficient space within the Haunted House. Please perform a second expansion.”

Not enough space? But there is so much empty space in the underground parking lot.

Chen Ge had expected to awaken to a new scenario, not another complication. He dressed and hurried from the Haunted House toward the park’s abandoned underground parking area. No visitor had entered it for one or two years, and the park had piled bulky refuse across both entrances to keep people away.

Climbing over the debris, Chen Ge entered the garage. New Century Park had spent heavily to build it during the park’s prime. After walking a considerable distance, he reached an old concrete wall separating the garage from the Haunted House scenarios. It extended to the ceiling, completely dividing the two spaces.

About two thirds of the place is empty, so why would it say there’s not enough space? Or one expansion can only fit three scenarios?

Before the first expansion, the Haunted House had contained three scenarios. That expansion added the Third Sick Hall, A Room of Three, and Mu Yang High School underground. This pattern supported his theory.

I didn’t even realize I already have six scenarios, but it’s still not enough!

As the sun rose, its rays filtered into the garage. Chen Ge noticed something interesting: every scenario stood beyond the sunlight’s reach. Whether this was deliberate—or whether sunlight weakened the black phone’s power—was unclear.

It’s better if I seal up the place completely. Today, I’ll get someone to block the two entrances. That way I’ll feel much better.

Chen Ge opened the expansion menu on the black phone. A second expansion required more than one thousand monthly visitors and a positive reputation above seventy.

He had met those requirements several days earlier but ignored the option, believing ample room remained in the garage.

“Do you wish to expand for the second time? There’s a chance of obtaining a unique construct.”

“Yes!”

Nothing changed after he confirmed the expansion.Perhaps it won’t begin until midnight.

Chen Ge pocketed the black phone and retraced his steps. He was anticipating the unique construct, but he would need to wait until the following day for the expansion to finish.

The park opened at nine, and Gu Feiyu arrived as promised. His timing was ideal; Chen Ge desperately needed more staff. Xiao Gu was brave, and Chen Ge hoped to place him in charge of Murder by Midnight, but first he needed to become familiar with the Haunted House.

Chen Ge therefore sent Gu Feiyu through the attraction with a group of visitors. After completing three scenarios, the weak-kneed young man insisted on leaving at any cost. Only after considerable effort did Chen Ge convince him that frightening others was very different from being frightened himself.

Still scared witless, Gu Feiyu refused to enter again that day. After further negotiation, he agreed to return the following morning. Watching him leave, Chen Ge found the young man rather endearing.

Chen Ge valued not only Gu Feiyu’s courage but also his character. Having once had his life saved by Chen Ge, the loyal young man would probably protect the Haunted House’s secrets no matter what he witnessed there.

The number of people that I can use is still too small.
